title: Internal hours split across rated and unrated locations show a part value
preconds:
1. A technician clocked internal hours at BOTH a location with a configured default labor rate and a location with NO rate, in the range.
2. Both locations are selected..
steps:
1. Read the technician's Internal Hours and Est. Lost Labor.
2. Compare the dollar value against rate × (internal hours at the RATED location only).
expected:
1. Est. Lost Labor is the sum of the valued (rated-location) portions only - the unrated-location hours are excluded from the dollar amount.
2. The amount shows as a normal "$X.XX" with NO partial-value indicator in this version - so the row's Est. Lost Labor values fewer hours than its Internal Hours column shows.
3. This is a documented known limitation (a partial-value indicator is a possible follow-up) - expected behavior, not a defect.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Technician Utilization report specification version 9 (S2-E4), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
